item.title: Cho Hyun: “There Are Multiple Potential Actors That Could Have Launched the Aircraft, Not Only Iran…Possibility of Militias” (조현 “비행체 발사할 주체, 이란만 해도 여럿...민병대 가능성도”)
item.description:
Cho Hyun: “There Are Multiple Potential Actors That Could Have Launched the Aircraft, Not Only Iran…Possibility of Militias” (조현 “비행체 발사할 주체, 이란만 해도 여럿...민병대 가능성도”)

Foreign Minister Cho Hyun stated on the 13th that it cannot be definitively concluded that the Iranian government was the entity that launched an unidentified aircraft at the South Korean vessel HMM Namu in the Strait of Hormuz, adding that there is also a possibility it could have been a militia. <<> Minister Cho met with reporters at the Government Complex Seoul and responded to a question about whether the aircraft that struck the Namu is likely a drone, saying, "It is difficult to specify at this point." He added, "In particular, there are multiple potential actors that could have fired such a thing, not only Iran. There could also be militias." <<> Minister Cho’s remarks are interpreted to mean that even if the aircraft that struck the Namu is confirmed to be an Iranian-made drone, as many experts have analyzed, it cannot be determined which Iranian entity launched it. <<> When asked whether he is also considering the possibility that the attacking entity could be a militia, Minister Cho responded, "It’s not that I’m considering it, but rather that there is a possibility." <<> Currently, experts are suggesting that the aircraft that struck the Namu could be a suicide drone such as the Shahed, which Iran has frequently used in its conflict with the United States. The Shahed is operated not only by Iran’s regular military and Revolutionary Guard, which developed the weapon, but also by the Houthi rebels and militias backed by Iran. <<> The government plans to bring the aircraft engine debris collected from the Namu back to South Korea for precise analysis to determine the attacking entity. When asked about the timing of the debris's arrival in South Korea, Minister Cho stated, "It should come quickly." (조현 외교부 장관은 13일 호르무즈 해협에서 한국 선박 HMM 나무호에 미상 비행체를 발사할만한 주체가 이란 정부라고 단정할 수 없고 민병대 등일 가능성도 있다고 했다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk: "Kim Yong-nam Will Block Prosecution Reform If Elected... I Will Complete the Reform" (조국 “김용남, 의원 되면 검찰 개혁 막을 것... 내가 개혁 마무리”)
item.description:
Cho Kuk: "Kim Yong-nam Will Block Prosecution Reform If Elected... I Will Complete the Reform" (조국 “김용남, 의원 되면 검찰 개혁 막을 것... 내가 개혁 마무리”)

Cho Kuk, candidate of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party running in the by-election for the National Assembly seat in Pyeongtaek-eul, Gyeonggi Province, claimed on the 13th that Kim Yong-nam, candidate of the Democratic Party of Korea, supports recognizing the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights, and that if Kim enters the National Assembly, he could oppose prosecution reform. Candidate Cho emphasized, "Completing prosecution reform is undoubtedly something I can do," insisting that he should be elected. He stated that discussions on unification could only take place two to three weeks later. <<> In an interview on MBC Radio’s 'Kim Jong-bae's Focus' that morning, Candidate Cho was pointed out by the host that the Cho Kuk Innovation Party had not fielded candidates for regional and local council seats in Pyeongtaek. In response, Cho said, "Doesn't the Democratic Party have candidates for Pyeongtaek mayor and regional and local council seats?" adding, "I believe votes should be concentrated on those individuals." <<> However, regarding the National Assembly seat, he stated, "I intend to clearly compete and win (against Candidate Kim, rather than concentrating votes for him)." <<> Candidate Cho cited the issue of 'prosecution reform' as the reason he must defeat Candidate Kim. He said, "Candidate Kim takes the position of recognizing the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights within the scope of the identity of the charges, but I believe, in principle, those rights should be abolished and only recognized in very exceptional, extreme cases." He added, "Prosecution reform needs to be completed, and who can do it? Undoubtedly, I am the one who can." <<> The host asked, "Does the outcome of prosecution reform change depending on which single lawmaker gets elected?" Candidate Cho replied, "It can change." He continued, "During the Moon Jae-in administration, a former prosecutor candidate named Cho Eung-cheon, recruited by President Moon, became a lawmaker and endlessly opposed prosecution reform. If (Candidate Kim is elected and becomes a lawmaker), something like this could happen again." Cho added, "Candidate Kim has never changed his stance on the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights. I predict that if he becomes a lawmaker in the future, he will either consistently oppose prosecution reform according to his convictions or block it in an insufficient manner." <<> When the host asked, "By that logic, are you saying the Democratic Party's candidate nomination itself was wrong?" Candidate Cho responded, "A political party has the right to recommend candidates based on its internal criteria and discussions. Since I am not a member of the Democratic Party, I am not qualified to comment on that." <<> Regarding the issue of unification with Candidate Kim or Candidate Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party, Cho stated, "This is not the time for candidates to discuss unification." He said, "It would be meaningful to discuss the unification issue two to three weeks later, after each candidate has shared their vision and values with voters, and after voters have had a chance to verify and evaluate them." (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 출마한 조국 조국혁신당 후보는 13일 김용남 더불어민주당 후보가 검찰의 보완 수사권을 인정하자는 입장이라며 김 후보가 국회에 입성하면 검찰 개혁을 반대할 수 있다고 주장했다. 조 후보는 “검찰 개혁 마무리는 단연코 제가 할 수 있다”며 자신이 당선돼야 한다고 강조했다. 단일화 논의는 2~3주 뒤에나 할 수 있다고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Won-oh: "Reduce Property Tax for Single-Home Owners with No Income"...Seongdong and Gangnam to Benefit (정원오 “소득 없는 1주택자 재산세 감면”…성동·강남 수혜)
item.description:
Jung Won-oh: "Reduce Property Tax for Single-Home Owners with No Income"...Seongdong and Gangnam to Benefit (정원오 “소득 없는 1주택자 재산세 감면”…성동·강남 수혜)

Jung Won-oh, a candidate of the Democratic Party of Korea, announced on the 13th a pledge to reduce property taxes for single-home owners with no income. This year, the publicly announced prices of apartment complexes in Seoul rose by 18.6% compared to last year, and the aim is to alleviate the property tax burden resulting from this increase. (정원오 더불어민주당 후보가 소득없는 1주택자의 재산세를 감면하겠다는 공약을 13일 내놨다. 올해 서울 공동주택 공시가격은 지난해 대비 18.6% 상승했는데, 이로 인한 재산세 부담을 경감해주겠다는 취지다.)

In particular, the districts of Seongdong and Gangnam, which have a high concentration of expensive apartments and thus saw a significant rise in publicly announced prices, are expected to benefit. Looking at this year's publicly announced apartment prices, Seongdong-gu, where candidate Jung Won-oh served as district mayor, recorded the highest fluctuation rate in Seoul at 28.98%. This was followed by Gangnam-gu (25.83%) and Songpa-gu (25.46%). (특히 고가 아파트가 밀집해 공시가격 상승률이 큰 성동구와 강남 지역이 수혜를 입을 것으로 보인다. 올해 공동주택 공시가격을 보면 정원오 후보가 구청장을 지낸 성동구가 28.98%로 서울에서 가장 높은 변동률을 보였다. 이어 강남구(25.83%), 송파구(25.46%) 순이었다.)

During a press conference on the same day, Candidate Jung stated, "Together with the 25 district mayor candidates of Seoul, we will promote a temporary measure to reduce the increase in property taxes this year resulting from the rise in publicly announced prices." He added, "This is about easing the property tax burden for retired generations who live in and protect their only home, not for multi-home owners with speculative purposes." (정 후보는 이날 회견에서 “서울시 25개 구청장 후보들과 함께, 공시가격 상승으로 올해 늘어난 재산세 증가분을 한시적으로 감면하는 조치를 추진하겠다”며 “투기 목적의 다주택자가 아니라, 평생 살아온 집 한 채를 지키며 살아가는 은퇴 세대의 재산세 부담을 덜어드리겠다는 것”이라고 했다.)

The target is limited to single-home owners who are above a certain age and have no business or earned income. It was stated that the age criteria would be reasonably reviewed, referencing the current comprehensive real estate tax senior citizen deduction standard of 60 years of age. (대상은 1주택자 중, 일정 연령 이상이면서 사업소득과 근로소득이 없는 시민으로 한정했다. 연령 기준은 현행 종합부동산세 고령자 세액공제 기준인 만 60세를 참고해 합리적으로 검토하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Furthermore, Candidate Jung announced, "We will push to reflect the reduction of this year's increase in the property tax levied in September, but depending on certain conditions, we will also consider handling the July portion through a refund method." (그러면서 정 후보는 “오는 9월 부과되는 재산세에 올해 증가분 감면이 반영될 수 있도록 추진하되, 일정 여건에 따라 7월분은 환급 방식으로 처리하는 방안도 검토하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, on the same day, Representative Kim Jae-seop of the People Power Party claimed regarding Candidate Jung's past assault record, "It had absolutely nothing to do with the May 18 Democratic Uprising," and "It was a case where, during a drinking session, he forced a café owner to have his female employee stay out overnight and threatened the owner when he refused." (한편, 이날 국민의힘 김재섭 의원은 정 후보의 과거 폭행 전과와 관련해 5·18 민주화운동과는 전혀 무관했다”며 “술자리에서 카페 주인에게 여종업원과의 외박을 강요하고 이를 거절하는 주인을 협박한 사건”이라고 주장했다.)

In response, Candidate Jung avoided answering that question during the Q&A session following the press conference. An aide to Jung stated, "Today, we will only answer questions related to the topic." This led to some friction with certain media outlets. (이에 대해 정 후보는 회견을 마치고 이어진 질의응답 과정에서 해당 답변을 피했다. 정 후보측은 “오늘은 질문과 관련해서만 답변을 하겠다”고 했다. 이 과정에서 일부 언론과 마찰이 빚어지기도 했다.)

Earlier, regarding this allegation, Candidate Jung's side issued a statement saying, "Representative Kim's claims are not true and are merely one-sided assertions," and added, "Representative Kim Jae-seop's claims are only one-sided arguments that include the stance of the then-Democratic Liberal Party." (앞서 해당 의혹에 대해 정 후보측은 입장문을 내고 “김 의원 주장은 사실이 아니며 일방적 주장에 불과하다”며 “김재섭 의원의 주장은 당시 민주자유당 측 주장만 담고 있는 일방적 주장일 뿐”이라고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Kim Yong-beom's remarks refer to 'excess tax revenue dividend'… Claims about excess profits are slander" (李대통령 “김용범 말은 ‘초과세수 배당’…초과이윤 주장은 음해")
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung directly refuted reports about Cheong Wa Dae policy chief Kim Yong-beom's mention of a national dividend on the 13th, calling them "slanderous fake news." (이재명 대통령은 13일 김용범 청와대 정책실장의 국민배당금 언급을 다룬 보도에 대해 “음해성 가짜뉴스”라고 직접 반박했다.)

President Lee wrote on X (formerly Twitter) that day, "What Director Kim said is that (we) are considering a plan to distribute the nation's excess tax revenue generated from excess profits in the artificial intelligence (AI) sector to the people." President Lee added, "Some media outlets edited this remark and spread slanderous fake news claiming that 'Director Kim argued for considering a plan to distribute corporate excess profits to the people.'" <<> He then questioned, "Even though Director Kim denied this and kindly provided an explanation, and related reports have been published, why do they still persist with such slanderous reporting?" adding, "Political criticism or blame, if not based on facts, harms democracy." <<> In a post on Facebook on the 11th, Director Kim said, "The fruits of the AI infrastructure era are not solely the result of specific companies," and mentioned a "national dividend system" to return them to the people. When controversy arose over this post, Kim explained, "It's about utilizing excess tax revenue." <<> However, foreign media reported that the stock market fell due to Kim's post, and opposition parties such as the People Power Party criticized it as "communist thinking." Cheong Wa Dae stated, "The content posted by Director Kim is a personal opinion unrelated to any internal discussions or reviews within Cheong Wa Dae." (이 대통령은 이날 X(엑스·옛 트위터)에 “김 실장이 한 말은 인공지능(AI) 부문 초과이윤으로 발생하는 국가의 초과 세수를 국민배당하는 방안(을) 검토(한다는 것)”라며 이같이 썼다. 이 대통령은 “일부 언론이 이 발언을 편집해 ‘김 실장이 기업의 초과이윤을 국민배당하는 방안 검토를 주장했다’는 음해성 가짜뉴스를 유포했다”고 했다.)

item.title: UN Human Rights Chief Expresses Interest in North Korea Human Rights Issues; PM Kim Says “Let’s Continue Communicating” (유엔 인권대표 “北 인권 문제에 관심” 金총리 “소통하자”)
item.description:
The UN High Commissioner for Human Rights expressed interest in North Korea’s human rights issues during a meeting with Prime Minister Kim Min-seok on the 13th. Prime Minister Kim responded, “Let’s continue to communicate.” (유엔 인권최고대표가 13일 김민석 국무총리를 만난 자리에서 북한 인권 문제에 대해 관심을 표했다. 김 총리는 “계속해서 소통해 나가자”고 답했다.)

According to the Prime Minister’s Office, UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk visited South Korea to attend the World Human Rights Cities Forum held in Gwangju and met with Prime Minister Kim at the Government Complex Seoul that morning. (총리실에 따르면, 볼커 튀르크 유엔 인권최고대표는 광주에서 열리는 세계인권도시포럼 참석차 방한해 이날 오전 정부서울청사에서 김 총리를 만났다.)

High Commissioner Türk told Prime Minister Kim, “I am pleased to visit South Korea, which is an important strategic partner of the Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) and contributes in various ways to the global human rights stage.” (튀르크 최고대표는 김 총리에게 “인권최고대표사무소(OHCHR)의 중요한 전략적 파트너이자 세계 인권 무대에서 다방면으로 기여하고 있는 한국을 방문해 기쁘게 생각한다”고 했다.)

He added, “Although there are many challenges, such as recent geopolitical crises and challenges to multilateralism, human rights can be a key to overcoming divisions and building trust in the fields of international peace and security,” and expressed hope to “continue strengthening cooperation with South Korea in the future.” (이어 “최근 지정학적 위기, 다자주의에 대한 도전 등 어려움이 많으나, 인권은 국제 평화·안보 분야에서 분열을 극복하고 신뢰를 구축하는 핵심 열쇠가 될 수 있다”며 “앞으로 한국과 협력을 지속 강화해 나가기를 희망한다”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Kim stated, “Our government places great importance on values such as human rights, democracy, and life.” He continued, “South Korea aims to repay the help it received from the international community in the past by contributing to global development and prosperity,” adding, “In this process, let’s work closely together between South Korea and the OHCHR.” (김 총리는 “우리 정부는 인권과 민주주의, 생명 등의 가치를 매우 중시한다”고 했다. 이어 “한국은 국제사회의 발전과 번영에 기여함으로써 과거 국제사회로부터 받은 도움을 되돌려주고자 한다”며 “이 과정에서 한국과 OHCHR이 긴밀히 협력해 나가자”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, High Commissioner Türk reportedly also showed interest in issues related to artificial intelligence (AI). In response, Prime Minister Kim introduced that “South Korea, as a leading AI nation, is pushing for the establishment of a ‘Global AI Hub’ in collaboration with UN agencies.” The Global AI Hub is a concept envisioned by the South Korean government to gather AI-related functions from various UN subsidiary bodies, specialized agencies, and partner organizations in one place to foster mutual cooperation, and South Korea has proposed its establishment to the UN. (한편 튀르크 최고대표는 인공지능(AI) 관련 이슈에도 관심을 표한 것으로 전해졌다. 그러자 김 총리는 “한국은 AI 선도 국가로서 유엔 기구들과 함께 하는 ‘글로벌 AI 허브’ 설립을 추진 중”이라고 소개했다. 글로벌 AI 허브는 유엔의 여러 산하기구와 전문기구, 협력기구에 있는 AI 관련 기능을 한곳에 모아 상호 협력하게 하자는 것으로, 한국 정부가 구상했으며 유엔에 이를 한국에 설립하자고 제안하고 있다.)

Prime Minister Kim said, “We aim to discuss ethics and standards surrounding AI through the Global AI Hub,” and added, “It would be good to have meaningful exchanges with the OHCHR from the perspective of AI and human rights.” (김 총리는 “글로벌 AI 허브를 통해 AI를 둘러싼 윤리와 표준 등에 관해 논의를 해 나가고자 한다”며 “AI와 인권이라는 관점에서 OHCHR 측과도 의미 있는 의견 교환이 이뤄지면 좋을 것”이라고 했다.)

In response, High Commissioner Türk expressed “strong support for the purpose of the Global AI Hub” and stated, “The OHCHR will also cooperate.” (이에 대해 튀르크 최고대표는 “글로벌 AI 허브의 취지에 적극 공감한다”며 “OHCHR로서도 협력해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

Additionally, High Commissioner Türk expressed interest in North Korea’s human rights issues, including the problems of separated families, abductees, and detainees. The OHCHR maintains an office in Seoul to monitor and document the human rights situation in North Korea. In this regard, High Commissioner Türk said, “The OHCHR intends to play its necessary role.” (아울러, 튀르크 최고대표는 이산가족, 납북자, 억류자 문제 등 북한 인권 문제에 대해서도 관심을 표명했다. OHCHR은 서울사무소를 두고 북한 인권 상황을 모니터링해 기록하고 있기도 하다. 이와 관련해 튀르크 최고대표는 “OHCHR 차원에서도 필요한 역할을 해 나가고자 한다”고 했다.)

In response, Prime Minister Kim said, “Let’s continue to communicate,” according to the Prime Minister’s Office. An official from the Prime Minister’s Office stated, “This was a general-level response, and there were no specific discussions.” (그러자 김 총리는 “계속해서 소통해 나가자”고 답했다고 총리실은 전했다. 총리실 관계자는 “일반적인 차원의 답변을 한 것이고, 구체적인 논의가 있었던 것은 아니다”라고 했다.)
